migration_strategy.target: pending ask records persist in the session store (sessions.db family) keyed (session_id, request_id)
migration_strategy.old_db_compat: forward migration: create the ask table/metadata on open when missing; no backfill from process memory (nothing to migrate); all serde fields #[serde(default)] so an old blob/DB opens unchanged
migration_strategy.open_question: the frozen protocol declares only a trait (no concrete constructor). The red test must be able to compile: it needs a named concrete implementor. Candidate: `impl AskPersistenceStore for SessionStore` backed by the sqlite backend, constructed via SessionStore::new()/with_backend(). Exact concrete type is taken from the frozen test when it lands (no impl written before red).

open_risks: T2 freeze has no concrete store type/constructor => red test compile risk (assertion-failure requirement); do not pre-implement before red
legacy expiry tests (ask_pending_contract / ask_pending_adversarial) will go red by design once TTL leaves product semantics; they are outside task-4 write scope
crates/pony-agent-core/src/agent/sqlite_session.rs is NOT in task-4 write scope although contract §2 names sessions.db; any table-in-sessions.db approach must live under src/agent/session/**
